claim: The AlphaClaw repository uses pnpm (pnpm-lock.yaml), so npm ci fails with EUSAGE; install with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and test with pnpm test. The fork PR 34 head c926b622 (0.9.39-9, upstream main 0.9.38-beta.1 already an ancestor) passed 112 test files and 876 tests on node 24.22.3 with openclaw 2026.10.6, plus node --check bin/alphaclaw.js.

decisions.notes: Dry run in a disposable worktree before touching the installed runtime, 2026-11-25.
